chunks: Those before them had also said so, and yet nothing of what they did availed them in the least.
ai.seo_question: What did the deeds of previous nations fail to achieve for them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar underscores the futility of worldly accumulation or mere verbal proclamation when divorced from sincere faith (Iman) and divine grace, echoing the fate of earlier nations like Pharaoh's followers. It serves as a critical reminder that deeds (Amal) must be coupled with true acceptance (Qabul) to be beneficial, a concept emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Majlisi in discussing the interplay between human effort and God's will.
